$schema_doc: merit-v4.4 asymmetric realism gate -- the gate sims the default/Career basis, which merit-v4.4 (CURRENT-basis-only re-rate) does NOT change; lambda is UNCHANGED from merit-v4.3 (no refit) and landings/shape bands carry over. Only the engine_version stamp moves. Runtime engine_version is engine-2026.06.16-merit-v4.4.
engine_anchor: merit-v4.4 current-basis re-rate; lambda unchanged (career sim distribution untouched)

strategicAutoDraft._doc: PASS-gate measurement target. Slot-fit best-available: for each spin, scan rolled_card_ids and pick max(positionCompatibility(eligible, slot_position) * rating[channel_for_slot]); tiebreak by overall DESC then card_id ASC. Manager-first flow + first-vacant slot order unchanged from canonical autoDraft.

autoDraft._doc: Canonical first-card autoDraft — TELEMETRY ONLY. Production engine fixture (byte-stable for goldens); a measurement artifact when used as the realism population (see docs/investigations/engine-v2-asymmetric-realism-2026-06-07.md).

greedyOverallAutoDraft._doc: Position-blind max-overall NEGATIVE CONTROL. The gate ASSERTS this policy lands OUTSIDE every shape band, so nobody can 'fix' realism by maxing OVR — competent must mean slot-fit-aware, not max-overall.

shape_bands._doc: merit-v4.4 carry-over: shape bands centered on strategicAutoDraft. lambda is UNCHANGED from merit-v4.3 because the gate sims the Career basis and merit-v4.4 only re-rates the Current basis; no refit was performed. Half-width = max(WilsonHalfWidthAroundObs at locked N, 1.5pp floor). The four shape norms are tracked together (each +/-halfWidth around the strategic golden); goals/game is handled separately as a one-sided LOWER floor (no upper cap -- total volume legitimately tracks the underdog gap).

goals_per_game_lower_floor._doc: One-sided LOWER floor. No upper cap because total goal volume legitimately rises with the strategic-underdog gap and there is no real-world ceiling. Floor = strategicAutoDraft observed minus ~2x Wilson half-width, rounded down to keep honest residual cushion.

wilson_target_for_ko_metrics._doc: 95% Wilson half-width at N=2000 for KO-only metrics (KO->ET, shootout) is the chosen-N tooth criterion. merit-v4.4 carries over the merit-v4.3 strategicAutoDraft observed half-widths (Career-basis sim unchanged).
